    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 332  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 333  ret
}

    o1.xyz = r1.xyz * r1.www + r9.xyz;                                                    // 352  mad o1.xyz, r1.xyzx, r1.wwww, r9.xyzx

    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 356  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 357  ret
}

        r7.w = d3d_sat(r7.w);                                                             // 1277  mov_sat r7.w, r7.w
        r2.x = d3d_sat(dot(r5.xyz, r1.xyz));                                              // 1278  dp3_sat r2.x, r5.xyzx, r1.xyzx
        r1.x = d3d_sat(dot(r1.xyz, r0.xyz));                                              // 1279  dp3_sat r1.x, r1.xyzx, r0.xyzx
        r1.y = r3.x * r3.z + 2.0;                                                         // 1280  mad r1.y, r3.x, r3.z, l(2.000000)
        r1.y = r1.y * FO4_L_INV_2PI;                                                      // 1281  mul r1.y, r1.y, l(0.159155)
        r1.z = d3d_log2(r1.x);                                                            // 1282  log r1.z, r1.x
        r1.z = r1.z * r6.w;                                                               // 1283  mul r1.z, r1.z, r6.w
        r1.z = d3d_exp2(r1.z);                                                            // 1284  exp r1.z, r1.z
        r1.y = r1.z * r1.y;                                                               // 1285  mul r1.y, r1.z, r1.y
        r1.z = d3d_max(r2.x, FO4_L_2POW_M23);                                             // 1286  max r1.z, r2.x, l(0.000000)
        r3.x = d3d_min(r6.y, r7.w);                                                       // 1287  min r3.x, r6.y, r7.w
        r1.x = r1.x + r1.x;                                                               // 1288  add r1.x, r1.x, r1.x
        r3.z = r1.x * r3.x;                                                               // 1289  mul r3.z, r1.x, r3.x
        b3.z = (r1.z >= r3.z);                                                            // 1290  ge r3.z, r1.z, r3.z
        b3.x = (r7.w == r3.x);                                                            // 1291  eq r3.x, r7.w, r3.x
        r6.x = d3d_div(r6.y, r7.w);                                                       // 1292  div r6.x, r6.y, r7.w
        r3.x = b3.x ? 1.0 : r6.x;                                                         // 1293  movc r3.x, r3.x, l(1.000000), r6.x
        r1.x = r1.x * r3.x;                                                               // 1294  mul r1.x, r1.x, r3.x
        r1.x = d3d_div(r1.x, r1.z);                                                       // 1295  div r1.x, r1.x, r1.z
        r1.z = d3d_div(1.0, r7.w);                                                        // 1296  div r1.z, l(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000), r7.w
        r1.x = b3.z ? r1.x : r1.z;                                                        // 1297  movc r1.x, r3.z, r1.x, r1.z
        r1.z = -r2.x + 1.0;                                                               // 1298  add r1.z, -r2.x, l(1.000000)
        r2.x = r1.z * r1.z;                                                               // 1299  mul r2.x, r1.z, r1.z
        r2.x = r2.x * r2.x;                                                               // 1300  mul r2.x, r2.x, r2.x
        r3.x = r1.z * r2.x;                                                               // 1301  mul r3.x, r1.z, r2.x
        r1.z = -r1.z * r2.x + 1.0;                                                        // 1302  mad r1.z, -r1.z, r2.x, l(1.000000)
        r1.z = r1.z * FO4_L_0_2 + r3.x;                                                   // 1303  mad r1.z, r1.z, l(0.200000), r3.x
        r1.z = d3d_min(r1.z, 1.0);                                                        // 1304  min r1.z, r1.z, l(1.000000)
        r1.x = r1.x * r1.z;                                                               // 1305  mul r1.x, r1.x, r1.z
        r1.x = r1.y * r1.x;                                                               // 1306  mul r1.x, r1.y, r1.x
        r1.x = r1.x * 0.25;                                                               // 1307  mul r1.x, r1.x, l(0.250000)
        r1.x = d3d_min(r1.x, 15.0);                                                       // 1308  min r1.x, r1.x, l(15.000000)
        r1.x = r3.y * r1.x;                                                               // 1309  mul r1.x, r3.y, r1.x
        r1.x = r1.x * FO4_L_PI;                                                           // 1310  mul r1.x, r1.x, l(3.141593)
        r1.xyz = r1.xxx * LightColor.xyz;                                                 // 1311  mul r1.xyz, r1.xxxx, cb2[2].xyzx
        r7.xyz = r6.yyy * r1.xyz;                                                         // 1312  mul r7.xyz, r6.yyyy, r1.xyzx

    r0.x = d3d_sat(dot(r0.xyz, r5.xyz));                                                  // 1314  dp3_sat r0.x, r0.xyzx, r5.xyzx
    r0.x = -r0.x + 1.0;                                                                   // 1315  add r0.x, -r0.x, l(1.000000)
    r0.x = d3d_log2(r0.x);                                                                // 1316  log r0.x, r0.x
    r0.x = r0.x * FO4_L_0_01;                                                             // 1317  mul r0.x, r0.x, l(0.010000)

    r0.x = r6.y * r0.x;                                                                   // 1321  mul r0.x, r6.y, r0.x
    r0.x = r0.w * r0.x;                                                                   // 1322  mul r0.x, r0.w, r0.x
    r0.xyz = r0.xxx * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 1323  mul r0.xyz, r0.xxxx, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = LightColor.xyz * r4.www + r0.xyz;                                            // 1324  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r4.wwww, r0.xyzx

    r1.xyz = r2.yzw * r0.www;                                                             // 1326  mul r1.xyz, r2.yzwy, r0.wwww

    r0.w = r3.w + r5.w;                                                                   // 1328  add r0.w, r3.w, r5.w
    r1.x = r3.w + 1.0;                                                                    // 1329  add r1.x, r3.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.w = d3d_sat(d3d_div(r0.w, r1.x));                                                  // 1330  div_sat r0.w, r0.w, r1.x
    r0.w = -r6.y + r0.w;                                                                  // 1331  add r0.w, -r6.y, r0.w
    r0.w = d3d_max(r0.w, 0.0);                                                            // 1332  max r0.w, r0.w, l(0.000000)
    r1.xyz = r0.www * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 1333  mul r1.xyz, r0.wwww, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = r1.xyz * r4.xyz + r0.xyz;                                                    // 1334  mad r0.xyz, r1.xyzx, r4.xyzx, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = r6.z * -0.5 + 1.0;                                                             // 1335  mad r0.w, r6.z, l(-0.500000), l(1.000000)
    r1.xyz = r0.www * r7.xyz;                                                             // 1336  mul r1.xyz, r0.wwww, r7.xyzx
    o1.xyz = r1.www * r1.xyz;                                                             // 1337  mul o1.xyz, r1.wwww, r1.xyzx
    r0.xyz = r1.www * r0.xyz;                                                             // 1338  mul r0.xyz, r1.wwww, r0.xyzx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 1339  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 1340  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1341  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 1342  ret
}

        r3.z = d3d_sat(r3.z);                                                             // 263  mov_sat r3.z, r3.z
        r4.w = -r3.z + 1.0;                                                               // 264  add r4.w, -r3.z, l(1.000000)
        r4.w = r4.w * r4.w;                                                               // 265  mul r4.w, r4.w, r4.w
        r4.w = r4.w * 0.25;                                                               // 266  mul r4.w, r4.w, l(0.250000)
        r9.w = 1.0;                                                                       // 267  mov r9.w, l(1.000000)
        r8.w = dot(DirectionalAmbient[0].xyzw, r9.xyzw);                                  // 268  dp4 r8.w, cb2[6].xyzw, r9.xyzw
        r10.x = dot(DirectionalAmbient[1].xyzw, r9.xyzw);                                 // 269  dp4 r10.x, cb2[7].xyzw, r9.xyzw
        r9.x = dot(DirectionalAmbient[2].xyzw, r9.xyzw);                                  // 270  dp4 r9.x, cb2[8].xyzw, r9.xyzw
        r11.x = d3d_log2(r8.w);                                                           // 271  log r11.x, r8.w
        r11.y = d3d_log2(r10.x);                                                          // 272  log r11.y, r10.x
        r11.z = d3d_log2(r9.x);                                                           // 273  log r11.z, r9.x
        r9.xyz = r11.xyz * vec3(FO4_L_2_2);                                               // 274  mul r9.xyz, r11.xyzx, l(2.200000, 2.200000, 2.200000, 0.000000)
        r9.xyz = vec3(d3d_exp2(r9.x), d3d_exp2(r9.y), d3d_exp2(r9.z));                    // 275  exp r9.xyz, r9.xyzx
        r9.xyz = r4.www * r9.xyz;                                                         // 276  mul r9.xyz, r4.wwww, r9.xyzx
        r8.xyz = r3.yyy * r9.xyz;                                                         // 277  mul r8.xyz, r3.yyyy, r9.xyzx
        r4.w = r7.x * FO4_L_M0_98 + 1.0;                                                  // 278  mad r4.w, r7.x, l(-0.980000), l(1.000000)
        r8.w = r3.x * r4.w;                                                               // 279  mul r8.w, r3.x, r4.w
        r1.xyz = -r1.xyz * r0.xxx + LightVector.xyz;                                      // 280  mad r1.xyz, -r1.xyzx, r0.xxxx, cb2[1].xyzx
        r0.x = dot(r1.xyz, r1.xyz);                                                       // 281  dp3 r0.x, r1.xyzx, r1.xyzx
        r0.x = d3d_rsq(r0.x);                                                             // 282  rsq r0.x, r0.x
        r1.xyz = r0.xxx * r1.xyz;                                                         // 283  mul r1.xyz, r0.xxxx, r1.xyzx
        r0.x = d3d_sat(dot(r0.yzw, r1.xyz));                                              // 284  dp3_sat r0.x, r0.yzwy, r1.xyzx
        r0.y = d3d_sat(dot(r1.xyz, r5.xyz));                                              // 285  dp3_sat r0.y, r1.xyzx, r5.xyzx
        r0.z = r3.x * r4.w + 2.0;                                                         // 286  mad r0.z, r3.x, r4.w, l(2.000000)
        r0.z = r0.z * FO4_L_INV_2PI;                                                      // 287  mul r0.z, r0.z, l(0.159155)
        r0.w = d3d_log2(r0.y);                                                            // 288  log r0.w, r0.y
        r0.w = r0.w * r8.w;                                                               // 289  mul r0.w, r0.w, r8.w
        r0.w = d3d_exp2(r0.w);                                                            // 290  exp r0.w, r0.w
        r0.z = r0.w * r0.z;                                                               // 291  mul r0.z, r0.w, r0.z
        r0.w = d3d_max(r0.x, FO4_L_2POW_M23);                                             // 292  max r0.w, r0.x, l(0.000000)
        r1.x = d3d_min(r6.w, r3.z);                                                       // 293  min r1.x, r6.w, r3.z
        r0.y = r0.y + r0.y;                                                               // 294  add r0.y, r0.y, r0.y
        r1.y = r0.y * r1.x;                                                               // 295  mul r1.y, r0.y, r1.x
        b1.y = (r0.w >= r1.y);                                                            // 296  ge r1.y, r0.w, r1.y
        b1.x = (r3.z == r1.x);                                                            // 297  eq r1.x, r3.z, r1.x
        r1.z = d3d_div(r6.w, r3.z);                                                       // 298  div r1.z, r6.w, r3.z
        r1.x = b1.x ? 1.0 : r1.z;                                                         // 299  movc r1.x, r1.x, l(1.000000), r1.z
        r0.y = r0.y * r1.x;                                                               // 300  mul r0.y, r0.y, r1.x
        r0.y = d3d_div(r0.y, r0.w);                                                       // 301  div r0.y, r0.y, r0.w
        r0.w = d3d_div(1.0, r3.z);                                                        // 302  div r0.w, l(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000), r3.z
        r0.y = b1.y ? r0.y : r0.w;                                                        // 303  movc r0.y, r1.y, r0.y, r0.w
        r0.x = -r0.x + 1.0;                                                               // 304  add r0.x, -r0.x, l(1.000000)
        r0.w = r0.x * r0.x;                                                               // 305  mul r0.w, r0.x, r0.x
        r0.w = r0.w * r0.w;                                                               // 306  mul r0.w, r0.w, r0.w
        r1.x = r0.w * r0.x;                                                               // 307  mul r1.x, r0.w, r0.x
        r0.x = -r0.x * r0.w + 1.0;                                                        // 308  mad r0.x, -r0.x, r0.w, l(1.000000)
        r0.x = r0.x * FO4_L_0_2 + r1.x;                                                   // 309  mad r0.x, r0.x, l(0.200000), r1.x
        r0.x = d3d_min(r0.x, 1.0);                                                        // 310  min r0.x, r0.x, l(1.000000)
        r0.x = r0.y * r0.x;                                                               // 311  mul r0.x, r0.y, r0.x
        r0.x = r0.z * r0.x;                                                               // 312  mul r0.x, r0.z, r0.x
        r0.x = r0.x * 0.25;                                                               // 313  mul r0.x, r0.x, l(0.250000)
        r0.x = d3d_min(r0.x, 15.0);                                                       // 314  min r0.x, r0.x, l(15.000000)
        r0.x = r3.y * r0.x;                                                               // 315  mul r0.x, r3.y, r0.x
        r0.x = r0.x * FO4_L_PI;                                                           // 316  mul r0.x, r0.x, l(3.141593)
        r0.xyz = r0.xxx * LightColor.xyz;                                                 // 317  mul r0.xyz, r0.xxxx, cb2[2].xyzx
        r7.yzw = r6.www * r0.xyz;                                                         // 318  mul r7.yzw, r6.wwww, r0.xxyz
    r1.y = intBitsToFloat(b1.y ? -1 : 0); }                                               // 319  endif
    r0.x = d3d_sat(-r2.z);                                                                // 320  mov_sat r0.x, -r2.z
    r0.xyz = r6.xyz * r0.xxx;                                                             // 321  mul r0.xyz, r6.xyzx, r0.xxxx
    r0.xyz = r0.xyz * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 322  mul r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = LightColor.xyz * r5.www + r0.xyz;                                            // 323  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r5.wwww, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = r2.z + r3.w;                                                                   // 324  add r0.w, r2.z, r3.w
    r1.x = r3.w + 1.0;                                                                    // 325  add r1.x, r3.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.w = d3d_sat(d3d_div(r0.w, r1.x));                                                  // 326  div_sat r0.w, r0.w, r1.x
    r0.w = -r6.w + r0.w;                                                                  // 327  add r0.w, -r6.w, r0.w
    r0.w = d3d_max(r0.w, 0.0);                                                            // 328  max r0.w, r0.w, l(0.000000)
    r1.xyz = r0.www * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 329  mul r1.xyz, r0.wwww, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = r1.xyz * r4.xyz + r0.xyz;                                                    // 330  mad r0.xyz, r1.xyzx, r4.xyzx, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = r7.x * -0.5 + 1.0;                                                             // 331  mad r0.w, r7.x, l(-0.500000), l(1.000000)
    r1.xyz = r0.www * r7.yzw;                                                             // 332  mul r1.xyz, r0.wwww, r7.yzwy
    o1.xyz = r1.xyz * r1.www + r8.xyz;                                                    // 333  mad o1.xyz, r1.xyzx, r1.wwww, r8.xyzx
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 334  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.xyz = r0.xyz * r1.www + r2.xyw;                                                    // 335  mad r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, r1.wwww, r2.xywx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 336  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 337  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 338  ret
}

    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 1346  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 1347  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1348  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)

        r0.w = r0.y * r0.y;                                                               // 912  mul r0.w, r0.y, r0.y
        r0.w = r0.w * r0.w;                                                               // 913  mul r0.w, r0.w, r0.w

        r0.y = -r0.y * r0.w + 1.0;                                                        // 915  mad r0.y, -r0.y, r0.w, l(1.000000)
        r0.y = r0.y * FO4_L_0_2 + r1.y;                                                   // 916  mad r0.y, r0.y, l(0.200000), r1.y

        r0.y = r1.x * r0.y;                                                               // 919  mul r0.y, r1.x, r0.y

    r0.w = r8.x * -0.5 + 1.0;                                                             // 945  mad r0.w, r8.x, l(-0.500000), l(1.000000)

    o1.xyz = r1.xyz * r1.www + r9.xyz;                                                    // 947  mad o1.xyz, r1.xyzx, r1.wwww, r9.xyzx

    r0.xyz = r0.xyz * r1.www + r6.xyz;                                                    // 949  mad r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, r1.wwww, r6.xyzx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 950  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 951  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)

// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3197_t09820202  technique 0x09820202 = DIRECTIONAL_SHADOW|SPECULAR|AMBIENT|FILTER_PCSSPOISSON|BLENDSPLIT|DIRSPLITS3
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3197, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, DirectionalAmbient = cb2[6].x, FadeDistances = cb2[10].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowWorldScale = cb2[21].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[24].x

    o1.xyzw = vec4(intBitsToFloat(0), intBitsToFloat(0), intBitsToFloat(0), 1.0);         // 126  mov o1.xyzw, l(0,0,0,1.000000)

}

    r1.x = r2.w + 1.0;                                                                    // 175  add r1.x, r2.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.w = d3d_sat(d3d_div(r0.w, r1.x));                                                  // 176  div_sat r0.w, r0.w, r1.x

    r0.xyz = r1.xyz * r3.xyz + r0.xyz;                                                    // 180  mad r0.xyz, r1.xyzx, r3.xyzx, r0.xyzx

    o1.xyz = r0.www * r6.yzw;                                                             // 182  mul o1.xyz, r0.wwww, r6.yzwy
    o0.xyz = r0.xyz * vec3(FO4_L_ONE_THIRD);                                              // 183  mul o0.xyz, r0.xyzx, l(0.333333, 0.333333, 0.333333, 0.000000)
    o0.w = intBitsToFloat(0);                                                             // 184  mov o0.w, l(0)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 185  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 186  ret
}

    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 184  mov r0.w, l(0)

    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 186  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)

        r0.y = d3d_sat(cb12_28.z * r0.y + r1.z);                                          // 126  mad_sat r0.y, cb12[28].z, r0.y, r1.z
        r0.x = d3d_min(r0.y, r0.x);                                                       // 127  min r0.x, r0.y, r0.x
    } else {                                                                              // 128  else
        r0.y = dot(r2.xyz, r4.xyz);                                                       // 129  dp3 r0.y, r2.xyzx, r4.xyzx

    r0.w = intBitsToFloat(b0.w ? -1 : 0); }                                               // 131  endif
    r0.xyw = r0.xxx * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 132  mul r0.xyw, r0.xxxx, cb2[2].xyxz
    r0.xyz = r0.zzz * r0.xyw;                                                             // 133  mul r0.xyz, r0.zzzz, r0.xywx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 134  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 135  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.xyzw = vec4(intBitsToFloat(0), intBitsToFloat(0), intBitsToFloat(0), 1.0);         // 136  mov o1.xyzw, l(0,0,0,1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 137  ret
}

    r0.xyz = r1.www * r0.xyz;                                                             // 270  mul r0.xyz, r1.wwww, r0.xyzx

    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 273  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)

}

        r0.y = r0.y * r0.w;                                                               // 182  mul r0.y, r0.y, r0.w

        r0.x = r0.x * 0.25;                                                               // 184  mul r0.x, r0.x, l(0.250000)
        r0.x = d3d_min(r0.x, 15.0);                                                       // 185  min r0.x, r0.x, l(15.000000)
        r0.x = r3.y * r0.x;                                                               // 186  mul r0.x, r3.y, r0.x
        r0.x = r0.x * FO4_L_PI;                                                           // 187  mul r0.x, r0.x, l(3.141593)
        r0.xyw = r0.xxx * LightColor.xyz;                                                 // 188  mul r0.xyw, r0.xxxx, cb2[2].xyxz
        r6.xyz = r2.www * r0.xyw;                                                         // 189  mul r6.xyz, r2.wwww, r0.xywx
    r2.x = intBitsToFloat(b2.x ? -1 : 0); r3.w = intBitsToFloat(b3.w ? -1 : 0); }         // 190  endif
    r0.xyw = r1.www * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 191  mul r0.xyw, r1.wwww, cb2[2].xyxz
    o1.xyz = r0.zzz * r6.xyz;                                                             // 192  mul o1.xyz, r0.zzzz, r6.xyzx
    r0.xyz = r0.zzz * r0.xyw;                                                             // 193  mul r0.xyz, r0.zzzz, r0.xywx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 194  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 195  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 196  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 197  ret
}

layout(binding = 0)  uniform sampler2D t0;
layout(binding = 1)  uniform sampler2D t1;
layout(binding = 2)  uniform sampler2D t2;
layout(binding = 3)  uniform sampler2D t3;
layout(binding = 5)  uniform sampler2DArrayShadow t5;
// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3234_t01224202  technique 0x01224202 = DIRECTIONAL_SHADOW|SPECULAR|IGNOREROUGHNESS|AMBIENT|FILTER_POISSON|BLENDSPLIT
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3234, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, DirectionalAmbient = cb2[6].x, FadeDistances = cb2[10].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[20].x, ShadowWorldScale = cb2[21].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[24].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3234(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{
    vec4 r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11;
    bvec4 b1, b3, b6, b7;
    ivec4 i0, i3, i6, i7, i8, i9;
    o0 = vec4(0.0); o1 = vec4(0.0);   // unwritten components (notas D9)
    kill = false;
    r0.xyzw = dflSvPosition.xyxy * VPOSOffset.xyzw;                                       // 1038  mul r0.xyzw, v0.xyxy, cb2[0].xyzw
    r1.x = dFdx(r0.x);                                                                    // 1039  deriv_rtx_coarse r1.x, r0.x
    r1.y = dFdy(r0.y);                                                                    // 1040  deriv_rty_coarse r1.y, r0.y
    r1.x = textureGrad(t3, r0.xy, r1.xx, r1.yy).x;                                        // 1041  sample_d_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r1.x, r0.xyxx, t3.xyzw, s3, r1.xxxx, r1.yyyy
    b1.y = (FO4_L_0_01 >= r1.x);                                                          // 1042  ge r1.y, l(0.010000), r1.x
    if (b1.y) {                                                                           // 1043  if_nz r1.y
        r2.z = r1.x * 100.0;                                                              // 1044  mul r2.z, r1.x, l(100.000000)
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[0].xyzw;                                                 // 1045  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[24].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[1].xyzw;                                                 // 1046  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[25].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[2].xyzw;                                                 // 1047  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[26].xyzw
        r6.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[3].xyzw;                                                 // 1048  mov r6.xyzw, cb12[27].xyzw
    } else {                                                                              // 1049  else
        r2.z = r1.x * FO4_L_1_01 + FO4_L_M0_01;                                           // 1050  mad r2.z, r1.x, l(1.010000), l(-0.010000)
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj[0].xyzw;                                                   // 1051  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[20].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj[1].xyzw;                                                   // 1052  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[21].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj[2].xyzw;                                                   // 1053  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[22].xyzw
        r6.xyzw = cb12_invproj[3].xyzw;                                                   // 1054  mov r6.xyzw, cb12[23].xyzw
    }                                                                                     // 1055  endif
    r0.zw = r0.zw * vec2(1.0, -1.0) + vec2(0.0, 1.0);                                     // 1056  mad r0.zw, r0.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000, -1.000000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000)
    r2.xy = r0.zw * vec2(2.0, 2.0) + vec2(-1.0, -1.0);                                    // 1057  mad r2.xy, r0.zwzz, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
    r2.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1058  mov r2.w, l(1.000000)
    r1.x = dot(r3.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1059  dp4 r1.x, r3.xyzw, r2.xyzw
    r1.y = dot(r4.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1060  dp4 r1.y, r4.xyzw, r2.xyzw
    r1.z = dot(r5.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1061  dp4 r1.z, r5.xyzw, r2.xyzw
    r0.z = dot(r6.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1062  dp4 r0.z, r6.xyzw, r2.xyzw

layout(binding = 0)  uniform sampler2D t0;
layout(binding = 1)  uniform sampler2D t1;
layout(binding = 2)  uniform sampler2D t2;
layout(binding = 3)  uniform sampler2D t3;
layout(binding = 5)  uniform sampler2DArrayShadow t5;
// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3244_t00200020  technique 0x00200020 = POINTSPOT_SHADOW|FILTER_POISSON
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3244, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, LightAttenuation = cb2[3].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[15].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[19].x, ShadowLightParam = cb2[20].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3244(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{
    vec4 r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10;
    bvec4 b1, b2, b6;
    ivec4 i0, i4, i5, i6, i8;
    o0 = vec4(0.0); o1 = vec4(0.0);   // unwritten components (notas D9)
    kill = false;
    r0.xyzw = dflSvPosition.xyxy * VPOSOffset.xyzw;                                       // 1038  mul r0.xyzw, v0.xyxy, cb2[0].xyzw
    r1.x = dFdx(r0.x);                                                                    // 1039  deriv_rtx_coarse r1.x, r0.x
    r1.y = dFdy(r0.y);                                                                    // 1040  deriv_rty_coarse r1.y, r0.y
    r1.x = textureGrad(t3, r0.xy, r1.xx, r1.yy).x;                                        // 1041  sample_d_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r1.x, r0.xyxx, t3.xyzw, s3, r1.xxxx, r1.yyyy
    b1.y = (FO4_L_0_01 >= r1.x);                                                          // 1042  ge r1.y, l(0.010000), r1.x
    if (b1.y) {                                                                           // 1043  if_nz r1.y
        r2.z = r1.x * 100.0;                                                              // 1044  mul r2.z, r1.x, l(100.000000)
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[0].xyzw;                                                 // 1045  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[24].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[1].xyzw;                                                 // 1046  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[25].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[2].xyzw;                                                 // 1047  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[26].xyzw
        r6.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[3].xyzw;                                                 // 1048  mov r6.xyzw, cb12[27].xyzw
    } else {                                                                              // 1049  else
        r2.z = r1.x * FO4_L_1_01 + FO4_L_M0_01;                                           // 1050  mad r2.z, r1.x, l(1.010000), l(-0.010000)
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj[0].xyzw;                                                   // 1051  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[20].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj[1].xyzw;                                                   // 1052  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[21].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj[2].xyzw;                                                   // 1053  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[22].xyzw
        r6.xyzw = cb12_invproj[3].xyzw;                                                   // 1054  mov r6.xyzw, cb12[23].xyzw
    }                                                                                     // 1055  endif
    r0.zw = r0.zw * vec2(1.0, -1.0) + vec2(0.0, 1.0);                                     // 1056  mad r0.zw, r0.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000, -1.000000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000)
    r2.xy = r0.zw * vec2(2.0, 2.0) + vec2(-1.0, -1.0);                                    // 1057  mad r2.xy, r0.zwzz, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
    r2.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1058  mov r2.w, l(1.000000)
    r1.x = dot(r3.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1059  dp4 r1.x, r3.xyzw, r2.xyzw

        r7.xy = vec2(d3d_div(r3.w, r7.x), d3d_div(r3.w, r7.y));                           // 1205  div r7.xy, r3.wwww, r7.xyxx
        r3.w = r7.y * FO4_L_0_45;                                                         // 1206  mul r3.w, r7.y, l(0.450000)
        r6.w = -r7.x * 0.5 + 1.0;                                                         // 1207  mad r6.w, -r7.x, l(0.500000), l(1.000000)
        r7.x = -r3.x * r3.x + 1.0;                                                        // 1208  mad r7.x, -r3.x, r3.x, l(1.000000)
        r7.y = -r1.w * r1.w + 1.0;                                                        // 1209  mad r7.y, -r1.w, r1.w, l(1.000000)
        r7.x = d3d_sat(r7.y * r7.x);                                                      // 1210  mul_sat r7.x, r7.y, r7.x
        r7.x = d3d_sqrt(r7.x);                                                            // 1211  sqrt r7.x, r7.x
        r1.w = d3d_max(r1.w, r3.x);                                                       // 1212  max r1.w, r1.w, r3.x
        r1.w = d3d_div(r7.x, r1.w);                                                       // 1213  div r1.w, r7.x, r1.w
        r3.z = d3d_max(r3.z, 0.0);                                                        // 1214  max r3.z, r3.z, l(0.000000)
        r3.z = r3.z * r3.w;                                                               // 1215  mul r3.z, r3.z, r3.w
        r1.w = r3.z * r1.w + r6.w;                                                        // 1216  mad r1.w, r3.z, r1.w, r6.w
        r0.x = r1.w * r4.w;                                                               // 1217  mul r0.x, r1.w, r4.w
        r1.xyz = -r1.xyz * r2.www + r2.xyz;                                               // 1218  mad r1.xyz, -r1.xyzx, r2.wwww, r2.xyzx
        r1.w = dot(r1.xyz, r1.xyz);                                                       // 1219  dp3 r1.w, r1.xyzx, r1.xyzx
        r1.w = d3d_rsq(r1.w);                                                             // 1220  rsq r1.w, r1.w
        r1.xyz = r1.www * r1.xyz;                                                         // 1221  mul r1.xyz, r1.wwww, r1.xyzx
        r3.x = d3d_sat(r3.x);                                                             // 1222  mov_sat r3.x, r3.x
        r1.w = d3d_sat(dot(r5.xyz, r1.xyz));                                              // 1223  dp3_sat r1.w, r5.xyzx, r1.xyzx
        r1.x = d3d_sat(dot(r1.xyz, r4.xyz));                                              // 1224  dp3_sat r1.x, r1.xyzx, r4.xyzx
        r1.y = r0.y + 2.0;                                                                // 1225  add r1.y, r0.y, l(2.000000)
        r1.y = r1.y * FO4_L_INV_2PI;                                                      // 1226  mul r1.y, r1.y, l(0.159155)
        r1.z = d3d_log2(r1.x);                                                            // 1227  log r1.z, r1.x
        r0.y = r0.y * r1.z;                                                               // 1228  mul r0.y, r0.y, r1.z
        r0.y = d3d_exp2(r0.y);                                                            // 1229  exp r0.y, r0.y
        r0.y = r0.y * r1.y;                                                               // 1230  mul r0.y, r0.y, r1.y
        r1.y = d3d_max(r1.w, FO4_L_2POW_M23);                                             // 1231  max r1.y, r1.w, l(0.000000)
        r1.z = d3d_min(r5.w, r3.x);                                                       // 1232  min r1.z, r5.w, r3.x
        r1.x = r1.x + r1.x;                                                               // 1233  add r1.x, r1.x, r1.x
        r2.w = r1.x * r1.z;                                                               // 1234  mul r2.w, r1.x, r1.z
        b2.w = (r1.y >= r2.w);                                                            // 1235  ge r2.w, r1.y, r2.w
        b1.z = (r3.x == r1.z);                                                            // 1236  eq r1.z, r3.x, r1.z
        r3.z = d3d_div(r5.w, r3.x);                                                       // 1237  div r3.z, r5.w, r3.x
        r1.z = b1.z ? 1.0 : r3.z;                                                         // 1238  movc r1.z, r1.z, l(1.000000), r3.z
        r1.x = r1.x * r1.z;                                                               // 1239  mul r1.x, r1.x, r1.z
        r1.x = d3d_div(r1.x, r1.y);                                                       // 1240  div r1.x, r1.x, r1.y
        r1.y = d3d_div(1.0, r3.x);                                                        // 1241  div r1.y, l(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000), r3.x
        r1.x = b2.w ? r1.x : r1.y;                                                        // 1242  movc r1.x, r2.w, r1.x, r1.y
        r1.y = -r1.w + 1.0;                                                               // 1243  add r1.y, -r1.w, l(1.000000)
        r1.z = r1.y * r1.y;                                                               // 1244  mul r1.z, r1.y, r1.y
        r1.z = r1.z * r1.z;                                                               // 1245  mul r1.z, r1.z, r1.z
        r1.w = r1.z * r1.y;                                                               // 1246  mul r1.w, r1.z, r1.y
        r1.y = -r1.y * r1.z + 1.0;                                                        // 1247  mad r1.y, -r1.y, r1.z, l(1.000000)
        r1.y = r1.y * FO4_L_0_2 + r1.w;                                                   // 1248  mad r1.y, r1.y, l(0.200000), r1.w
        r1.y = d3d_min(r1.y, 1.0);                                                        // 1249  min r1.y, r1.y, l(1.000000)
        r1.x = r1.x * r1.y;                                                               // 1250  mul r1.x, r1.x, r1.y
        r0.y = r0.y * r1.x;                                                               // 1251  mul r0.y, r0.y, r1.x
        r0.y = r0.y * 0.25;                                                               // 1252  mul r0.y, r0.y, l(0.250000)
        r0.y = d3d_min(r0.y, 15.0);                                                       // 1253  min r0.y, r0.y, l(15.000000)
        r0.y = r3.y * r0.y;                                                               // 1254  mul r0.y, r3.y, r0.y
        r0.y = r0.y * FO4_L_PI;                                                           // 1255  mul r0.y, r0.y, l(3.141593)
        r1.xyz = r0.yyy * LightColor.xyz;                                                 // 1256  mul r1.xyz, r0.yyyy, cb2[2].xyzx
        r6.xyz = r5.www * r1.xyz;                                                         // 1257  mul r6.xyz, r5.wwww, r1.xyzx
    r2.w = intBitsToFloat(b2.w ? -1 : 0); }                                               // 1258  endif
    r0.y = d3d_sat(dot(r4.xyz, r5.xyz));                                                  // 1259  dp3_sat r0.y, r4.xyzx, r5.xyzx
    r0.y = -r0.y + 1.0;                                                                   // 1260  add r0.y, -r0.y, l(1.000000)
    r0.y = d3d_log2(r0.y);                                                                // 1261  log r0.y, r0.y
    r0.y = r0.y * FO4_L_0_01;                                                             // 1262  mul r0.y, r0.y, l(0.010000)
    r0.y = d3d_exp2(r0.y);                                                                // 1263  exp r0.y, r0.y
    r1.x = d3d_sat(dot(r5.xyz, -r2.xyz));                                                 // 1264  dp3_sat r1.x, r5.xyzx, -r2.xyzx
    r0.y = r0.y * r1.x;                                                                   // 1265  mul r0.y, r0.y, r1.x
    r0.y = r5.w * r0.y;                                                                   // 1266  mul r0.y, r5.w, r0.y
    r0.y = r0.z * r0.y;                                                                   // 1267  mul r0.y, r0.z, r0.y
    r1.xyz = r0.yyy * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 1268  mul r1.xyz, r0.yyyy, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = LightColor.xyz * r0.xxx + r1.xyz;                                            // 1269  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r0.xxxx, r1.xyzx
    o1.xyz = r0.www * r6.xyz;                                                             // 1270  mul o1.xyz, r0.wwww, r6.xyzx
    r0.xyz = r0.www * r0.xyz;                                                             // 1271  mul r0.xyz, r0.wwww, r0.xyzx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 1272  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 1273  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1274  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 1275  ret
}

vec4 d3d_icb(int i) { return (i >= 0 && i < 1000) ? uintBitsToFloat(uvec4(icb_bits[4 * i], icb_bits[4 * i + 1], icb_bits[4 * i + 2], icb_bits[4 * i + 3])) : vec4(0.0); }
layout(binding = 3)  uniform sampler2D t3;
layout(binding = 5)  uniform sampler2DArrayShadow t5;
// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3251_t00200820  technique 0x00200820 = POINTSPOT_SHADOW|ATTENUATION_ONLY|FILTER_POISSON
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3251, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, LightAttenuation = cb2[3].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[15].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[19].x, ShadowLightParam = cb2[20].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3251(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{
    vec4 r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6;
    bvec4 b0, b1, b2;
    ivec4 i0, i1, i2, i3, i4;
    o0 = vec4(0.0); o1 = vec4(0.0);   // unwritten components (notas D9)
    kill = false;
    r0.xyzw = dflSvPosition.xyxy * VPOSOffset.xyzw;                                       // 1032  mul r0.xyzw, v0.xyxy, cb2[0].xyzw
    r1.x = dFdx(r0.x);                                                                    // 1033  deriv_rtx_coarse r1.x, r0.x
    r1.y = dFdy(r0.y);                                                                    // 1034  deriv_rty_coarse r1.y, r0.y
    r0.x = textureGrad(t3, r0.xy, r1.xx, r1.yy).x;                                        // 1035  sample_d_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r0.x, r0.xyxx, t3.xyzw, s3, r1.xxxx, r1.yyyy
    b0.y = (FO4_L_0_01 >= r0.x);                                                          // 1036  ge r0.y, l(0.010000), r0.x
    if (b0.y) {                                                                           // 1037  if_nz r0.y
        r1.z = r0.x * 100.0;                                                              // 1038  mul r1.z, r0.x, l(100.000000)
        r2.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[0].xyzw;                                                 // 1039  mov r2.xyzw, cb12[24].xyzw
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[1].xyzw;                                                 // 1040  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[25].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[2].xyzw;                                                 // 1041  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[26].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[3].xyzw;                                                 // 1042  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[27].xyzw
    } else {                                                                              // 1043  else
        r1.z = r0.x * FO4_L_1_01 + FO4_L_M0_01;                                           // 1044  mad r1.z, r0.x, l(1.010000), l(-0.010000)
        r2.xyzw = cb12_invproj[0].xyzw;                                                   // 1045  mov r2.xyzw, cb12[20].xyzw
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj[1].xyzw;                                                   // 1046  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[21].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj[2].xyzw;                                                   // 1047  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[22].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj[3].xyzw;                                                   // 1048  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[23].xyzw
    }                                                                                     // 1049  endif
    r0.xy = r0.zw * vec2(1.0, -1.0) + vec2(0.0, 1.0);                                     // 1050  mad r0.xy, r0.zwzz, l(1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(0.000000, 1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
    r1.xy = r0.xy * vec2(2.0, 2.0) + vec2(-1.0, -1.0);                                    // 1051  mad r1.xy, r0.xyxx, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
    r1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1052  mov r1.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.x = dot(r2.xyzw, r1.xyzw);                                                         // 1053  dp4 r0.x, r2.xyzw, r1.xyzw
    r0.y = dot(r3.xyzw, r1.xyzw);                                                         // 1054  dp4 r0.y, r3.xyzw, r1.xyzw
    r0.z = dot(r4.xyzw, r1.xyzw);                                                         // 1055  dp4 r0.z, r4.xyzw, r1.xyzw
    r0.w = dot(r5.xyzw, r1.xyzw);                                                         // 1056  dp4 r0.w, r5.xyzw, r1.xyzw
    r0.xyz = vec3(d3d_div(r0.x, r0.w), d3d_div(r0.y, r0.w), d3d_div(r0.z, r0.w));         // 1057  div r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, r0.wwww
    r1.xyz = -r0.xyz + LightVector.xyz;                                                   // 1058  add r1.xyz, -r0.xyzx, cb2[1].xyzx
    r1.x = dot(r1.xyz, r1.xyz);                                                           // 1059  dp3 r1.x, r1.xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.x = d3d_sqrt(r1.x);                                                                // 1060  sqrt r1.x, r1.x

    r2.z = b1.y ? r1.x : r1.z;                                                            // 204  movc r2.z, r1.y, r1.x, r1.z

    r1.xyz = r1.xyz * r6.xyz;                                                             // 207  mul r1.xyz, r1.xyzx, r6.xyzx

    r0.xyz = r0.www * r0.xyz;                                                             // 209  mul r0.xyz, r0.wwww, r0.xyzx

    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 211  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 212  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 213  ret

    r0.y = d3d_log2(r0.y);                                                                // 1267  log r0.y, r0.y
    r0.y = r0.y * FO4_L_0_01;                                                             // 1268  mul r0.y, r0.y, l(0.010000)
    r0.y = d3d_exp2(r0.y);                                                                // 1269  exp r0.y, r0.y
    r1.x = d3d_sat(dot(r5.xyz, -r2.xyz));                                                 // 1270  dp3_sat r1.x, r5.xyzx, -r2.xyzx
    r0.y = r0.y * r1.x;                                                                   // 1271  mul r0.y, r0.y, r1.x
    r0.y = r6.x * r0.y;                                                                   // 1272  mul r0.y, r6.x, r0.y
    r0.y = r0.z * r0.y;                                                                   // 1273  mul r0.y, r0.z, r0.y
    r1.xyz = r0.yyy * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 1274  mul r1.xyz, r0.yyyy, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = LightColor.xyz * r0.xxx + r1.xyz;                                            // 1275  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r0.xxxx, r1.xyzx
    r1.x = r5.w * 0.5 + 0.5;                                                              // 1276  mad r1.x, r5.w, l(0.500000), l(0.500000)
    r1.y = r7.y * 0.5;                                                                    // 1277  mul r1.y, r7.y, l(0.500000)
    r7.w = b6.w ? r1.x : r1.y;                                                            // 1278  movc r7.w, r6.w, r1.x, r1.y
    r1.xyz = texture(t7, r7.xw).xyz;                                                      // 1279  sample_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r1.xyz, r7.xwxx, t7.xyzw, s7
    r0.xyz = r0.xyz * r1.xyz;                                                             // 1280  mul r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, r1.xyzx
    r1.xyz = r1.xyz * r8.xyz;                                                             // 1281  mul r1.xyz, r1.xyzx, r8.xyzx
    o1.xyz = r0.www * r1.xyz;                                                             // 1282  mul o1.xyz, r0.wwww, r1.xyzx
    r0.xyz = r0.www * r0.xyz;                                                             // 1283  mul r0.xyz, r0.wwww, r0.xyzx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 1284  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 1285  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1286  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 1287  ret
}

    Fo4DflPs_rec3254(o0, o1, kill);

layout(binding = 1)  uniform sampler2D t1;

// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3256_t00201220  technique 0x00201220 = POINTSPOT_SHADOW|SPECULAR|GOBOPROJECTION|FILTER_POISSON
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3256, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, LightAttenuation = cb2[3].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[15].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[19].x, ShadowLightParam = cb2[20].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3256(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{
    vec4 r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11;
    bvec4 b1, b2, b3, b6;
    ivec4 i0, i5, i6, i8, i9;
    o0 = vec4(0.0); o1 = vec4(0.0);   // unwritten components (notas D9)

        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[1].xyzw;                                                 // 1048  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[25].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[2].xyzw;                                                 // 1049  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[26].xyzw

        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj[1].xyzw;                                                   // 1054  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[21].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj[2].xyzw;                                                   // 1055  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[22].xyzw

    r1.z = dot(r5.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1063  dp4 r1.z, r5.xyzw, r2.xyzw

        o0.xyzw = intBitsToFloat(ivec4(0, 0, 0, 0));                                      // 1080  mov o0.xyzw, l(0,0,0,0)
        o1.xyzw = intBitsToFloat(ivec4(0, 0, 0, 0));                                      // 1081  mov o1.xyzw, l(0,0,0,0)

    }                                                                                     // 1083  endif

    r2.xyz = r0.zzz * r2.xyz;                                                             // 1085  mul r2.xyz, r0.zzzz, r2.xyzx

    r4.xy = texture(t1, r0.xy).xy;                                                        // 1087  sample_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r4.xy, r0.xyxx, t1.xyzw, s1
    r4.xy = r4.xy * vec2(4.0, 4.0) + vec2(-2.0, -2.0);                                    // 1088  mad r4.xy, r4.xyxx, l(4.000000, 4.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-2.000000, -2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
    r0.z = dot(r4.xy, r4.xy);                                                             // 1089  dp2 r0.z, r4.xyxx, r4.xyxx
    r4.zw = -r0.zz * vec2(0.25, 0.5) + vec2(1.0, 1.0);                                    // 1090  mad r4.zw, -r0.zzzz, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.250000, 0.500000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000)
    r0.z = d3d_sqrt(r4.z);                                                                // 1091  sqrt r0.z, r4.z
    r4.xy = r0.zz * r4.xy;                                                                // 1092  mul r4.xy, r0.zzzz, r4.xyxx

    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1278  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)

        r1.x = r1.y * r1.x;                                                               // 667  mul r1.x, r1.y, r1.x
        r1.y = d3d_max(r0.y, FO4_L_2POW_M23);                                             // 668  max r1.y, r0.y, l(0.000000)
        r1.z = d3d_min(r0.w, r7.w);                                                       // 669  min r1.z, r0.w, r7.w
        r0.z = r0.z + r0.z;                                                               // 670  add r0.z, r0.z, r0.z
        r3.x = r0.z * r1.z;                                                               // 671  mul r3.x, r0.z, r1.z
        b3.x = (r1.y >= r3.x);                                                            // 672  ge r3.x, r1.y, r3.x
        b1.z = (r0.w == r1.z);                                                            // 673  eq r1.z, r0.w, r1.z
        r3.z = d3d_div(r7.w, r0.w);                                                       // 674  div r3.z, r7.w, r0.w
        r1.z = b1.z ? 1.0 : r3.z;                                                         // 675  movc r1.z, r1.z, l(1.000000), r3.z
        r0.z = r0.z * r1.z;                                                               // 676  mul r0.z, r0.z, r1.z
        r0.z = d3d_div(r0.z, r1.y);                                                       // 677  div r0.z, r0.z, r1.y
        r0.w = d3d_div(1.0, r0.w);                                                        // 678  div r0.w, l(1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000, 1.000000), r0.w
        r0.z = b3.x ? r0.z : r0.w;                                                        // 679  movc r0.z, r3.x, r0.z, r0.w
        r0.y = -r0.y + 1.0;                                                               // 680  add r0.y, -r0.y, l(1.000000)
        r0.w = r0.y * r0.y;                                                               // 681  mul r0.w, r0.y, r0.y
        r0.w = r0.w * r0.w;                                                               // 682  mul r0.w, r0.w, r0.w
        r1.y = r0.w * r0.y;                                                               // 683  mul r1.y, r0.w, r0.y
        r0.y = -r0.y * r0.w + 1.0;                                                        // 684  mad r0.y, -r0.y, r0.w, l(1.000000)
        r0.y = r0.y * FO4_L_0_2 + r1.y;                                                   // 685  mad r0.y, r0.y, l(0.200000), r1.y
        r0.y = d3d_min(r0.y, 1.0);                                                        // 686  min r0.y, r0.y, l(1.000000)
        r0.y = r0.z * r0.y;                                                               // 687  mul r0.y, r0.z, r0.y
        r0.y = r1.x * r0.y;                                                               // 688  mul r0.y, r1.x, r0.y
        r0.y = r0.y * 0.25;                                                               // 689  mul r0.y, r0.y, l(0.250000)
        r0.y = d3d_min(r0.y, 15.0);                                                       // 690  min r0.y, r0.y, l(15.000000)
        r0.y = r3.y * r0.y;                                                               // 691  mul r0.y, r3.y, r0.y
        r0.y = r0.y * FO4_L_PI;                                                           // 692  mul r0.y, r0.y, l(3.141593)
        r0.yzw = r0.yyy * LightColor.xyz;                                                 // 693  mul r0.yzw, r0.yyyy, cb2[2].xxyz
        r8.yzw = r7.www * r0.yzw;                                                         // 694  mul r8.yzw, r7.wwww, r0.yyzw
    r3.x = intBitsToFloat(b3.x ? -1 : 0); }                                               // 695  endif
    r0.y = r5.w * FO4_L_0_01;                                                             // 696  mul r0.y, r5.w, l(0.010000)
    r0.y = d3d_exp2(r0.y);                                                                // 697  exp r0.y, r0.y
    r0.z = d3d_sat(dot(r2.xyw, -LightVector.xyz));                                        // 698  dp3_sat r0.z, r2.xywx, -cb2[1].xyzx
    r0.y = r0.z * r0.y;                                                                   // 699  mul r0.y, r0.z, r0.y
    r0.y = r7.w * r0.y;                                                                   // 700  mul r0.y, r7.w, r0.y
    r0.x = r0.x * r0.y;                                                                   // 701  mul r0.x, r0.x, r0.y
    r0.xyz = r0.xxx * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 702  mul r0.xyz, r0.xxxx, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = LightColor.xyz * r4.www + r0.xyz;                                            // 703  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r4.wwww, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = d3d_sat(-r2.z);                                                                // 704  mov_sat r0.w, -r2.z
    r1.xyz = r7.xyz * r0.www;                                                             // 705  mul r1.xyz, r7.xyzx, r0.wwww
    r0.xyz = LightColor.xyz * r1.xyz + r0.xyz;                                            // 706  mad r0.xyz, cb2[2].xyzx, r1.xyzx, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = r2.z + r3.w;                                                                   // 707  add r0.w, r2.z, r3.w
    r1.x = r3.w + 1.0;                                                                    // 708  add r1.x, r3.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.w = d3d_sat(d3d_div(r0.w, r1.x));                                                  // 709  div_sat r0.w, r0.w, r1.x
    r0.w = -r7.w + r0.w;                                                                  // 710  add r0.w, -r7.w, r0.w
    r0.w = d3d_max(r0.w, 0.0);                                                            // 711  max r0.w, r0.w, l(0.000000)
    r1.xyz = r0.www * LightColor.xyz;                                                     // 712  mul r1.xyz, r0.wwww, cb2[2].xyzx
    r0.xyz = r1.xyz * r4.xyz + r0.xyz;                                                    // 713  mad r0.xyz, r1.xyzx, r4.xyzx, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = r8.x * -0.5 + 1.0;                                                             // 714  mad r0.w, r8.x, l(-0.500000), l(1.000000)
    r1.xyz = r0.www * r8.yzw;                                                             // 715  mul r1.xyz, r0.wwww, r8.yzwy
    o1.xyz = r1.xyz * r1.www + r9.xyz;                                                    // 716  mad o1.xyz, r1.xyzx, r1.wwww, r9.xyzx
    o1.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 717  mov o1.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.xyz = r0.xyz * r1.www + r6.xyz;                                                    // 718  mad r0.xyz, r0.xyzx, r1.wwww, r6.xyzx
    i0.w = 0;                                                                             // 719  mov r0.w, l(0)
    o0.xyzw = vec4(d3d_div(r0.x, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.y, 3.0), d3d_div(r0.z, 3.0), d3d_div(intBitsToFloat(i0.w), 3.0));// 720  div o0.xyzw, r0.xyzw, l(3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000, 3.000000)
    return;                                                                               // 721  ret
}

layout(binding = 0)  uniform sampler2D t0;
layout(binding = 1)  uniform sampler2D t1;
layout(binding = 2)  uniform sampler2D t2;
layout(binding = 3)  uniform sampler2D t3;
layout(binding = 5)  uniform sampler2DArrayShadow t5;
// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3260_t0020C020  technique 0x0020C020 = POINTSPOT_SHADOW|IGNOREROUGHNESS|IGNORERIM|FILTER_POISSON
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3260, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, LightAttenuation = cb2[3].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[15].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[19].x, ShadowLightParam = cb2[20].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3260(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{
    vec4 r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9;
    bvec4 b0, b1, b2, b5;
    ivec4 i0, i2, i4, i5, i7;
    o0 = vec4(0.0); o1 = vec4(0.0);   // unwritten components (notas D9)
    kill = false;
    r0.xyzw = dflSvPosition.xyxy * VPOSOffset.xyzw;                                       // 1038  mul r0.xyzw, v0.xyxy, cb2[0].xyzw
    r1.x = dFdx(r0.x);                                                                    // 1039  deriv_rtx_coarse r1.x, r0.x
    r1.y = dFdy(r0.y);                                                                    // 1040  deriv_rty_coarse r1.y, r0.y
    r1.x = textureGrad(t3, r0.xy, r1.xx, r1.yy).x;                                        // 1041  sample_d_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r1.x, r0.xyxx, t3.xyzw, s3, r1.xxxx, r1.yyyy
    b1.y = (FO4_L_0_01 >= r1.x);                                                          // 1042  ge r1.y, l(0.010000), r1.x
    if (b1.y) {                                                                           // 1043  if_nz r1.y
        r2.z = r1.x * 100.0;                                                              // 1044  mul r2.z, r1.x, l(100.000000)
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[0].xyzw;                                                 // 1045  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[24].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[1].xyzw;                                                 // 1046  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[25].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[2].xyzw;                                                 // 1047  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[26].xyzw
        r6.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[3].xyzw;                                                 // 1048  mov r6.xyzw, cb12[27].xyzw
    } else {                                                                              // 1049  else
        r2.z = r1.x * FO4_L_1_01 + FO4_L_M0_01;                                           // 1050  mad r2.z, r1.x, l(1.010000), l(-0.010000)
        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj[0].xyzw;                                                   // 1051  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[20].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj[1].xyzw;                                                   // 1052  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[21].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj[2].xyzw;                                                   // 1053  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[22].xyzw
        r6.xyzw = cb12_invproj[3].xyzw;                                                   // 1054  mov r6.xyzw, cb12[23].xyzw
    }                                                                                     // 1055  endif
    r0.zw = r0.zw * vec2(1.0, -1.0) + vec2(0.0, 1.0);                                     // 1056  mad r0.zw, r0.zzzw, l(0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000, -1.000000), l(0.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000)
    r2.xy = r0.zw * vec2(2.0, 2.0) + vec2(-1.0, -1.0);                                    // 1057  mad r2.xy, r0.zwzz, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)
    r2.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 1058  mov r2.w, l(1.000000)
    r1.x = dot(r3.xyzw, r2.xyzw);                                                         // 1059  dp4 r1.x, r3.xyzw, r2.xyzw

// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3262, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, LightAttenuation = cb2[3].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[15].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[19].x, ShadowLightParam = cb2[20].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3262(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{

layout(binding = 1)  uniform sampler2D t1;
layout(binding = 2)  uniform sampler2D t2;
layout(binding = 3)  uniform sampler2D t3;

// b10_DFLight_PS_rec3266_t00220202  technique 0x00220202 = DIRECTIONAL_SHADOW|SPECULAR|AMBIENT|FILTER_POISSON
// constants by name (fxp offset table of rec3266, loader 0x14181DDD0, obj+0x58; names 0x142271590): VPOSOffset = cb2[0].x, LightVector = cb2[1].x, LightColor = cb2[2].x, DirectionalAmbient = cb2[6].x, SplitDistances = cb2[9].x, FadeDistances = cb2[10].x, ShadowMapProj = cb2[11].x, ShadowSampleParam = cb2[20].x, ShadowWorldScale = cb2[21].x, ShadowFadeParam = cb2[24].x
void Fo4DflPs_rec3266(out vec4 o0, out vec4 o1, out bool kill)
{

        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[1].xyzw;                                                 // 1046  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[25].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj1p[2].xyzw;                                                 // 1047  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[26].xyzw

        r3.xyzw = cb12_invproj[0].xyzw;                                                   // 1051  mov r3.xyzw, cb12[20].xyzw
        r4.xyzw = cb12_invproj[1].xyzw;                                                   // 1052  mov r4.xyzw, cb12[21].xyzw
        r5.xyzw = cb12_invproj[2].xyzw;                                                   // 1053  mov r5.xyzw, cb12[22].xyzw

    r4.xyzw = texture(t0, r0.xy).xyzw;                                                    // 1065  sample_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r4.xyzw, r0.xyxx, t0.xyzw, s0
    r0.xy = texture(t1, r0.xy).xy;                                                        // 1066  sample_indexable(texture2d)(float,float,float,float) r0.xy, r0.xyxx, t1.xyzw, s1
    r0.xy = r0.xy * vec2(4.0, 4.0) + vec2(-2.0, -2.0);                                    // 1067  mad r0.xy, r0.xyxx, l(4.000000, 4.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000), l(-2.000000, -2.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000)

    r5.z = -r0.w;                                                                         // 1072  mov r5.z, -r0.w
